question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Inaffectual**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word "**Inaffectual**" is misspelled. The correct spelling of the word is "**Ineffectual**."
 
• **Ineffectual **means not producing any of the desired effects. (निष्प्रभावी)
 
 
• **Example**: The measures taken by the committee were largely **ineffectual **in mitigating the crisis.
 
 
 
• Hence, the incorrect spelling is **Inaffectual**.

Therefore, the correct answer is “**Option 3**”.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Authority**: It means the power or right to give orders, make decisions, and enforce obedience. (अधिकार)

 
 
• **Example**: The manager has the **authority **to make decisions regarding project assignments.
 
 
 
• **Illegitimate**: This word means not authorized by the law; not in accordance with accepted standards or rules. (अवैध)
 
 
• **Example**: The election was considered **illegitimate **due to the widespread evidence of vote tampering.
 
 
 
• **Authentic**: Authentic means of undisputed origin and not a copy; genuine. (प्रामाणिक)
 
 
• **Example**: The museum is known for its collection of **authentic **artifacts from the ancient period.
